items.title: Steady Draw: the roll dialog's 2dE chip, paid on a Tier 2 or 3
items.do: In a combat, open Kaela's Basic Attack roll dialog (her bow) against Goblin Sneak and tick the chip "Reaction Point: 2dE more on a Tier 2 or 3". Roll until one roll gets a Tier 1 and another a Tier 2 or 3 (tick the chip each time), then roll its damage. Open the roll dialog once more.
items.expect: The chip is off until ticked; ticked, the Tier 2 and Tier 3 previews show +2d4 (2d6 at Escalation 3, 2d8 at 4...). On a Tier 1 nothing is spent and the chip is offered again. On a Tier 2 or 3 her Reaction Point is spent and the damage shows 2 more dice named Steady Draw (the bow's subtype, no exploding dice). After that, the chip is gone for the rest of the combat; with no Reaction Point left, a warning and no extra dice. The chat card has no 2dE button any more.

items.title: Tumble: the Check against the targeted creatures' DC, then the movement past enemies
items.do: On Kaela's turn, target Goblin Sneak and use Tumble (1 AP). In the chat card, click Instinct Check, then the card's Move button, and drag her through the Goblin's square. Then target both Goblin Sneak and Orc Warrior, use Tumble (2 AP: Evade 2) and click Appeal Check; pass between them corner to corner.
items.expect: The roll dialog says "vs Goblin Sneak" and its DC is the Goblin's Instinct DC (11 + its Instinct), not 13. With two targets: the higher of their Appeal DCs and 1 Bane. With no target: DC 13. The movement passes the enemies; she can't end in an enemy's square.
